content: सावष्टम्भ {%a.%} .²1 Proud, dignified, noble, majestic. .²2 Courageous, resolute. .²3 Bold, vigorous, vehement; सावष्टम्भनिशुम्भसंभ्रमनमत् … … <ls>Māl. 5. 22</ls>. .²4 Full of firmness; सभायां वक्ति सामर्षः सावष्टम्भो नरः शुचिः <ls>Pt. 1. 200</ls>. .{@-म्भम्@} {%ind.%} Resolutely, firmly, courageously.
